pretreatments.description: Mechanical degradation: zucchini stem was cut into 3–5 mm pieces.
Chemical pretreatment with 2% KOH (mass concentration), stored at room temperature for 24 h with a moisture content of 95%.
Chemical pretreatment with 4% NaOH (mass concentration), stored at room temperature for 24 h with a moisture content of 95%.
Chemical pretreatment with 4% alkaline hydrogen peroxide (AHP) (mass concentration), with pH value adjusted to 11.5 by adding NaOH, stored at room temperature for 24 h with a moisture content of 95%.
